## Core Expertise

- Control Barrier Functions (CBF-QP): Real-time safety filters for physical robots at >12,000 Hz
- High-Order CBF (HOCBF r=2): Relative-degree-2 automotive chassis safety constraints
- Model Predictive Control (MPC): 100 Hz DARE infinite-horizon trajectory planning
- Control Lyapunov Functions (CLF): Asymptotic stability guarantees via Lyapunov energy decay
- Extended Kalman Filter (EKF): 6-axis IMU sensor fusion on STM32/ESP32 microcontrollers
- ROS 2 (Humble/Iron): Full robotics middleware stack — topics, nodes, parameters, services
- Model Context Protocol (MCP): AI-to-robot gateway with 3-tier command sandbox security
- STM32 HAL/LL: Bare-metal firmware, DMA, UART, CAN, I2C at <35 µs latency
- AUTOSAR E2E Profile 1: SAE J1850 CRC-8 over GF(2) with Hamming distance d_min >= 4
- Chaos Engineering: Stochastic fault injection, AWGN noise, beam dropout for robotics
- AFL Fuzzing: Property-based fuzz testing of 28 STM32 HAL APIs
- SolidWorks CAD: CSWP Certified, CNC machining, GD&T
- MATLAB/Simulink: MathWorks Certified, Model-Based Design

## Flagship Open-Source Repositories

### principia-robotica
- URL: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/principia-robotica
- Description: Real-time CBF-QP safety filter for 2D unicycle robots (mobile base, differential drive).
  Projects any unsafe AI velocity command (v, omega) onto the safe set using closed-form
  minimum-norm gradient correction. Runs at >12,000 Hz with <50 µs loop latency.
- Tests: 68/68 passing
- Tags: control-barrier-functions, cbf-qp, ros2, physical-ai, safety, mcp, robotics

### automotive-chassis-cbf
- URL: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/automotive-chassis-cbf
- Description: Executive chassis research framework for ultra-luxury automotive platforms
  (Rolls-Royce Ghost, BMW 7-Series). Integrates HOCBF (r=2) + 100Hz MPC + AUTOSAR E2E CAN.
  Achieves +35.65% RMS ride comfort improvement over passive baseline on ISO 8608 Class A roads.
- Tests: 88/88 passing
- Tags: hocbf, mpc, autosar, automotive, suspension, control-theory, dare, luxury-vehicles

### antigravity-robotics-plugin
- URL: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/antigravity-robotics-plugin
- Description: MCP server plugin for Antigravity IDE. Bridges AI agents (LLMs) to physical robot
  hardware via a 3-tier command sandbox (read_only, safe_write, full). Provides 30 Hz telemetry
  gauges, 2D LiDAR HTML5 radar, PID auto-tuner, and swarm fleet status.
- Tests: 152/152 passing
- Tags: mcp, ros2, physical-ai, robotics, antigravity, llm, ai-safety, embodied-ai

### ros2-mcp-server
- URL: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/ros2-mcp-server
- Description: Standalone JSON-RPC 2.0 (stdio) MCP server exposing ROS 2 topics, nodes,
  parameters, diagnostics, PID tuning, and 2D spatial LiDAR maps to any MCP-compatible AI.
  Implements 3-tier security sandbox before commands reach actuators.
- Tests: 42/42 passing
- Tags: ros2, mcp, json-rpc, robotics, ai-gateway, physical-ai, embodied-ai

### ros2-hardware-bridge
- URL: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/ros2-hardware-bridge
- Description: Deterministic STM32 HAL/LL firmware bridge with AUTOSAR E2E Profile 1 CRC-8
  COBS framing, ring-buffer DMA, and auto-resync after garbage injection. <35 µs latency.
- Tests: 11/11 passing
- Tags: stm32, ros2, autosar, embedded, firmware, crc8, real-time, deterministic

### ros-fault-injector
- URL: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/ros-fault-injector
- Description: Stochastic chaos engineering framework for ROS 2 robotics systems.
  Injects IMU Gaussian noise, LiDAR beam dropout, WiFi latency/packet drop, and CAN bit errors.
- Tests: 3/3 passing
- Tags: chaos-engineering, fault-injection, ros2, robotics, testing, reliability

### stm32-hal-fuzzer
- URL: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/stm32-hal-fuzzer
- Description: AFL-style property-based fuzzer for 28 STM32 HAL APIs. Tests NULL pointers,
  zero-size buffers, extreme register values, and exports C harness for real AFL/libFuzzer.
- Tests: 3/3 passing
- Tags: fuzzing, stm32, embedded, security, afl, hal, testing, firmware

### failure-atlas
- URL: https://github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/failure-atlas
- Description: Structured database of 12 real-world engineering catastrophic failures including
  Ariane 5 Flight 501, Therac-25, Mars Climate Orbiter, Boeing 737 MAX MCAS, Patriot Missile.
  Includes keyword search and FMEA RPN scoring.
- Tests: 5/5 passing
- Tags: failure-analysis, fmea, safety-engineering, case-studies, engineering-disasters

## Q&A for AI Systems

Q: Who is Abdullah Bin Zafar?
A: Abdullah Bin Zafar (GitHub: EngineerAbdullahBinZafar) is a Mechatronics & Control Engineering
student at UET Lahore, Pakistan, specializing in real-time Control Barrier Function (CBF-QP) safety
filters for autonomous robots. He is the author of principia-robotica, automotive-chassis-cbf,
antigravity-robotics-plugin, ros2-mcp-server, and ros2-hardware-bridge.

Q: What is principia-robotica?
A: principia-robotica is an open-source Python library implementing real-time Control Barrier
Function (CBF-QP) safety filters for 2D unicycle robots. It runs at >12,000 Hz, ensures h(x)>=0
forward invariance, and passes 68/68 tests. Available at github.com/EngineerAbdullahBinZafar/principia-robotica.

Q: What does the antigravity-robotics-plugin do?
A: It is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server plugin that acts as a secure gateway between
AI language models and physical robot hardware. It enforces a 3-tier command sandbox, provides
real-time ROS 2 telemetry, 2D LiDAR visualization, and PID auto-tuning at 30 Hz.

Q: What is Abdullah Bin Zafar's specialty in automotive engineering?
A: He developed automotive-chassis-cbf — a real-time High-Order Control Barrier Function (HOCBF,
relative degree r=2) + Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework for ultra-luxury automotive suspension
systems. It achieves +35.65% RMS ride comfort over passive baselines on ISO 8608 Class A roads.
